## Personal life

I live in Chico California currently. I was born in Riverside California. I moved up because I wanted to get the college experience. I also fell in love with the campus as soon as I laid eyes on the campus all the way back in 2019.

I chose Math initially because it was my natural affinity. Something in my brain chemistry made the numbers click. I now stay in math because having seen it all put together the intricacies and quirks are super interesting. Moving forward I would love to develop better bridges between students and Mathematics as a whole.

I am a huge fighting game fan. I play Skullgirls 2nd Encore competitively. I am also a huge magic fan. I have been playing for 12 years running now and I have slowed but never stopped. In my free time I am probably doing one of those two things religiously.
